lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 004: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: check:all has pre-existing failures in lint (runPostMerge cognitive complexity in post-merge.ts) and file-size (src/supervisor/events.ts:344>290, src/ui/SetupScreen.tsx:290>254, test/vendor/cam-ship-hygiene.test.ts:91>50, src/commands/setup.ts:697>650). These were failing before US-R1-004 and are not introduced by this story.
nextStoryContext: US-R1-004 fixed the missing logEvent wiring in sidecar.ts: the production runMergeWatch call inside the ci-gated closure was omitting the logEvent argument, so merge-watch-watching/merged/ci-red/post-merge-done events never reached cam-worker-events.jsonl. The fix adds a logEvent: (kind, detail) => logEvent({ ts, storyId: undefined, uuid: 'sidecar', kind, detail }) adapter in the runMergeWatch call. A new oracle test in test/release/merge-watch.test.ts reads sidecar.ts source and asserts logEvent: is present in the call, preventing silent regression. 1657 tests pass total.
